pay_adjustments_target.name: pay_adjustments_target
pay_adjustments_target.value: "core"."pay_adjustments"."route_execution_id" is not null or "core"."pay_adjustments"."pay_period_id" is not null

route_executions_status_payee.name: route_executions_status_payee
route_executions_status_payee.value: ("core"."route_executions"."execution_status" in ('confirmed', 'changed') and "core"."route_executions"."payee_id" is not null) or ("core"."route_executions"."execution_status" = 'no_driver' and "core"."route_executions"."payee_id" is null) or "core"."route_executions"."execution_status" in ('proposed', 'waiting')

work_records_grain_tier.name: work_records_grain_tier
work_records_grain_tier.where: "core"."work_records"."extra_job_id" is null and "core"."work_records"."service_tier_id" is not null
